recent: Waja Konsortium 于11月初获得一份价值 RM190 million 的柔佛新山建筑合约。公司将于12月8日召开第23届常年股东大会，并已发布2026年报及股东通函。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）营收环比增长70.3%，但净利环比下降38.3%。
notable: 子公司获得一份价值 RM190 million 的柔佛新山建筑合约。
将于2026年12月8日召开第23届常年股东大会。
发布2026年报及股东通函，涉及续延现有股东授权进行经常性关联交易。
earnings: 2026年9月30日止季度营收为 RM6.375 million，环比增长70.3%，但同比下降21.5%；净利为 RM37,000，环比下降38.3%，同比下降93.5%，净利率从上一季度的1.6%降至0.6%。

recent_en: Waja Konsortium secured a RM190 million construction contract in Johor Bahru in early November. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 70.3% QoQ while net profit fell 38.3% QoQ.
notable_en: A subsidiary secured a RM190 million building contract in Johor Bahru.
The 23rd Annual General Meeting will be held on 8 December 2026.
Issued the 2026 annual report and a circular to shareholders on the proposed renewal of the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM6.375 million, up 70.3% QoQ but down 21.5% YoY; net profit was RM37,000, down 38.3% QoQ and 93.5% YoY, with net margin falling to 0.6% from 1.6% in the previous quarter.
